subject: Mutual plan & implementation timeline — OncoHealth integration
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@oncohealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: OncoHealth Procurement <procurement@oncohealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood integration and timeline — request for MAP

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and the ability to pin model versions. We have an internal milestone to have a production-ready integration for our "Treatment Insights" feature by Aug 15, 2026.

Can you share a mutual action plan (high level milestones, owners, and target dates) and an initial SOW draft so our procurement and engineering teams can align? Key constraints on our side: SOC2 evidence by June 4, dev sandbox availability by June 14, and a user-acceptance window in early August.

I've attached a short requirements brief for context.

Regards,
Emily Zhao
Director, Product 
OncoHealth

Attachment: OncoHealth-SOW-requirements.pdf (PDF, 320KB)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@oncohealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood integration and timeline — request for MAP

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear ask and the requirements brief. We're excited to partner. I've attached a working draft of the mutual plan (spreadsheet) and an early SOW pdf for procurement to review.

High-level proposed timeline (first pass):
- June 4: SOC2 evidence package delivered to OncoHealth procurement (owner: Redwood Security)
- June 14: Dev sandbox and API keys available (owner: Redwood Platform Engineering)
- June 28: Integration smoke tests complete (owner: OncoHealth engineering)
- July 19: End-to-end QA and performance tuning (joint)
- Aug 1–10: UAT window (OncoHealth)
- Aug 15: Production cutover target

Next steps I propose: 1) confirm above milestone owners, 2) quick kick-off call (30 min) this week to lock on actions, 3) procurement review of SOW and timeline.

I'll leave Karthik and Priya on copy — Priya will be the CS lead and will run the onboarding cadence; Karthik will support with integration gating and SLA questions.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20260518-draft-map.xlsx (Excel, 45KB); SOW-OncoHealth-v1.pdf (PDF, 180KB)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: OncoHealth MAP — owners & deliverables (draft)

Team — looping you in to align on delivery cadence for OncoHealth. Emily asked for a MAP and SOW; procurement wants SOC2 evidence by June 4. Below is my recommendation for owners and dates. Please reply with any changes by EOD Wednesday.

Proposed milestones (owner — target):
- Security evidence handoff (Security) — 2026-06-04
- Sandbox provisioning and API keys (Platform Eng: Karthik) — 2026-06-14
- Integration smoke & auth tests (Customer Eng: OncoHealth; Redwood support: Marcus) — 2026-06-28
- Performance tuning (Redwood runtime team: Marcus) — 2026-07-12
- UAT window (OncoHealth) — 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-10
- Cutover (prod) — 2026-08-15

Critical gating items we must own:
1) Package SOC2 artifacts + short summary doc (owner: Security)
2) Sandbox token lifecycle and KV cache config for OncoHealth (owner: Platform Engineering)
3) Alerting and per-route cost dashboards set up in console for their account (owner: CS Ops)
4) Fallback policy: hold canary on smaller model variant if peak load > threshold (owner: Runtime)

I'll consolidate replies into the drive MAP and send a single summary to Emily Friday.

Grace

(P.S. Marcus — please confirm whether we can provide a pre-quantized model variant for reduced infra cost during UAT without impacting fidelity.)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 14:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: OncoHealth MAP — owners & deliverables (draft)

Thanks Grace. Quick updates from runtime/engineering perspective:

- Pre-quantized variant: yes, we can stand up a q4_8 variant for UAT. Fidelity checks should be part of the smoke tests (Marcus to own).
- Sandbox provisioning: Karthik, we'll need the OncoHealth service account + IP allowlist by June 10 to hit the June 14 target.
- Security evidence: attaching the checklist we usually send to procurement. We should add a one-page summary for them with timeline and contacts.

Proposed technical gating dates:
- June 4: Security artifacts delivered (we will provide the evidence bundle)
- June 10: Input needed from OncoHealth (service account, IP list, sample payloads)
- June 14: Sandbox live; smoke tests begin

I've attached the security checklist for procurement review. I'll coordinate with Platform Eng and Security to ensure the evidence package is compiled.

Marcus
Senior Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachment: security-evidence-checklist.docx (DOCX, 60KB)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@oncohealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: Proposed mutual plan + timeline for OncoHealth (attached)

Hi Emily — following our internal alignment, please find the proposed mutual action plan and timeline below (also attached in the Drive link). We've kept your go-live target of Aug 15 and aligned owners for each milestone.

Summary of milestones and owners (final):
- 2026-06-04: Security evidence package delivered (owner: Redwood Security)
- 2026-06-10: OncoHealth provides service account + IP allowlist + sample payloads (owner: OncoHealth)
- 2026-06-14: Dev sandbox provisioned, API keys issued, q4_8 pre-quantized variant available (owner: Redwood Platform Eng / Runtime)
- 2026-06-28: Integration smoke tests complete (owners: OncoHealth eng + Redwood Marcus)
- 2026-07-12: Performance tuning and alerting set (owner: Redwood Runtime + CS Ops)
- 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-10: UAT window (owner: OncoHealth)
- 2026-08-15: Prod cutover target (owner: joint)

Actions for this week:
1) Emily: confirm SOC2 evidence is sufficient for procurement or list any gaps by Wed (May 27).
2) OncoHealth engineering: share service account details and IP allowlist by June 10.
3) Redwood: we'll share the Drive MAP and finalize SOW for routing to your procurement (DocuSign link included).

Links & artifacts: Drive MAP (editable): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Onc0Health-Redwood-MAP
SOW (for procurement review / signature): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/SOW-OncoHealth-v1
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/ONC-2026-087

If that all looks good, I'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff for Thursday at 10:00 AM PT to walk through owners and the SOC2 packet handoff.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
